angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 608,194 km at 57.80 pc = 0.14 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 17.3017 +/- 0.0141 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 57.80 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.874219 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6281 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract): 608,194 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.714 (0.674 to 0.755) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4533.23 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6281 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6281 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-6281.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.409, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6281 (pscomppars): [M/H] -0.09 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6281 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.68565, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5383645268208106752, flags_flame 00: age_flame 10.588248 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 6.9457717 to 13.462029)
